page_title: NOT 1-1 BRE | Nottingham Forest v Brentford 01/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+13' Brentford take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+10' The current number of shots on goal is 1:5.
90+7' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+7' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
90+5' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
90+4' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90' There will be a minimum of 13 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Kristoffer Ajer is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
89' Substitution. Vitaly Janelt did his best and is replaced by Michael Olakigbe (Brentford).
89' The ball is out of play and Brentford manage to earn a corner.
88' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Frank Onyeka (Brentford) gets booked.
87' Neal Maupay (Brentford) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Matt Turner.
85' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
84' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 45:55.
81' A substitution has been made. Taiwo Awoniyi is replaced by Chris Wood (Nottingham).
80' Here comes a substitution. Divock Origi (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas Dominguez.
80' A quickly taken corner by Brentford.
79' Looks like Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
77' Steven Cooper has decided to substitute Ibrahim Sangare and he is replaced by Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham).
76' None of the Brentford players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
75' The referee allows time for a substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter will be replaced by Neal Maupay (Brentford).
73' The current number of shots on goal is 1:3.
69' The substitution is prepared. Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aaron Hickey.
69' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Mathias Jensen is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
68' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is booked.
65' 1 - 1 Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the roof of the net. Excellent finish.
60' Steven Cooper has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) replacing Anthony Elanga.
60' Substitution. Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Callum Hudson-Odoi walks off.
59' Referee Paul Tierney points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Brentford players celebrate.
59' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Brentford players aren’t happy.

58' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Mathias Jensen sends a cross in from the set piece and Christian Norgaard (Brentford) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes inside the left post and the score changes to 0:1.
56' Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) receives his second yellow card of the match and is sent off by the referee!
56' It’s not actually clear who made that challenge, so referee Paul Tierney will consult VAR before possibly issuing a red card.

54' A cross by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
53' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
52' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' The Brentford players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
50' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Christian Norgaard (Brentford) but poses no threat.
48' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Paul Tierney blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45+2' A loose ball is pounced on by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Matt Turner is alert and makes a comfortable save. Now Brentford have a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' The cross into the penalty area from Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
43' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
40' A cross from Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
37' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Paul Tierney no option but to blow his whistle.
36' The Brentford players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
35' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:0.
31' Brentford win a corner.
30' Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
27' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
27' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
26' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

23' Good chance! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
20' Brentford control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
15' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nottingham.
10' The goal by Nottingham is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
9' Wait! Referee Paul Tierney immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
8' A goal, which was scored by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham), was disallowed due to offside.
8' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nottingham.
7' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Matt Turner intercepts the ball.
6' Neat passing move from Brentford in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Paul Tierney will supervise the game today.
